structured_output.what_is_happening: 币安中秋 ("Binance Mid-Autumn") launched directly as a PumpSwap pool ~36 min before detection (not a pump.fun curve migration; migrated_unix 0), with ~150 SOL creator-supplied LP that is 0% locked/burned. Volume $470k in first hour on a $20k mcap, driven by 2,055 unique buyers vs only 53 unique sellers (≈1,000 buyers in one 15-30 min window) — a pattern consistent with bot-farmed holder counts/volume. At least 10 identical-name tokens were launched in the preceding ~9 hours, all now at $0 liquidity, suggesting a serial launch-pump-pull operation. Price now declining (-23% m5 on DexScreener fetch).
